text:
maya (prod): FYI preflight for release/2026.3.1 just ran. Prompt eval for summarization set shows a regression vs baseline (median ROUGE down ~6%). Change window today 14:00-15:00 UTC. Need decision: pin model back, proceed with canary and monitor, or hold?

deploy-bot: preflight-check complete. SUMMARY:
- suite: prompt-eval/summarization-eval-v2
- result: FAIL
- delta: median_rouge -6.2%
- failing_cases: 3/47
Commands: `/release pin model:<version>` | `/release approve --force` | `/release hold`

jess (qa): I ran the failing examples. Regressions are concentrated on long-context items (>=1024 tokens) and some multi-sentence coherence cases. Quick bisect points at v2.5.0 changes to tokenization + int8 quant profile. Sample failing ids: `s-112, s-178, s-305`

leo (eng): Reproduced locally on GPU with int8 quantization. Without quant (fp16) we don't see the same drop. Hypothesis: quantization+tokenization tweak in v2.5.0 interacting. We can either pin to v2.4.0 (no-int8) or ship v2.5.0 but disable int8 quant profile in the serving config for now.

sre-oncall: Heads-up — Dedicated customers scheduled to get the update in the 14:00 window. If we delay, we need to notify support and adjust the change window. Also note we have a 30-min SLA window for automated canary.

tom (pm): Product prefers safety here. Let's not push a release that lowers quality. We should pin to 2.4.0 for the release branch and open a triage ticket. Inform sales/support.

maya (prod): Agreed with product/qa. Decision: HOLD the live rollout. Action items:
- pin release branch to model v2.4.0 for rollout (maya)
- open INF ticket to triage tokenization+quant regression (jess)
- notify support + sales about delay (tom)

maya (prod): deploy-bot, please execute: `/release pin model:v2.4.0 target=release/2026.3.1 reason="prompt-eval regression - summarization-eval-v2"`

deploy-bot: /release pin acknowledged.
- Release: release/2026.3.1 pinned to model v2.4.0
- Canary schedule remains 14:00 UTC but will use pinned model
- Created INF ticket INF-4872: "summarization-eval regression after v2.5.0 - triage tokenization/quant"

jess (qa): I'll add failing transcripts and evaluation diff artifacts to INF-4872. Will start a focused bisect on tokenization changes.

leo (eng): I'll spin a short-blocking branch to revert the tokenization change for testing and test int8 variants. ETA 2 hours.

sre-oncall: Noted. I'll prepare a short support blurb and schedule a 10-min post-mortem slot in ops channel after the canary.

tom (pm): I'll update the release notes draft: "Release held pending prompt-eval regression. Model pinned to v2.4.0. Investigation in INF-4872." Also pinging sales.

maya (prod): Thanks — tagging @channel in the release thread: hold in place, will reconvene after triage. :white_check_mark:

jess (qa): :thumbsup:
